answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 33032 Country: India Title: My que is i have interest money with me. can i purchase fazaail e aamal with this money and hand it over to my poor relative without any intention of reward. Question: My que is i have interest money with me. can i purchase fazaail e aamal with this money and hand it over to my poor relative without any intention of reward. Answer ID: 33032 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1140/1140/M=1432) You should give the same interest money to your poor relative without the intention of reward. He may spend it as per his needs anywhere he wishes. He may buy Fazail Amal as well. سبيل الكسب الخبيث التصدق إذا تعذر الرد على صاحبه (شامى). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
